name: Hakobi Logistics
description: Hakobi Logistics — a theme for a logistics company (warehousing, line haul, last mile and customs), laid out as sticky media under a formal top header: the company name and tagline on the left, a Get a quote button and a menu button on the right, the menu always opening as a full bengara overlay. Bengara red (#9A3A33) is the main colour: the network section, the quote band, every page head and the overlay menu are bengara fields in white type. The front page is a locations network: one unframed full-bleed film-grain photograph of a loading dock at dusk with a two-line headline, a navy info bar with a tracking field, hub count, next-day coverage and a quote button; then a sticky line map of fourteen hubs beside the scrolling hub list, a lead-time table, four services as one-line rows, a wide depot photograph with a caption, four regional desks and a narrow quote band where a transparent cut-out pallet of boxes breaks above the band edge. Photographs are realistic film-grain images (35mm film, 50mm f/2, natural side light, fine grain, slightly faded, graded toward bengara). Zen Kaku Gothic New for headings, Archivo Narrow for text, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: Hero full-bleed-illustration is a full-bleed film-grain photograph, because the 2026-10-18 rule asks commercial themes for realistic photographs; the break-frame object is a transparent cut-out pallet of boxes over the quote band.

summary.zh-TW: 弁柄紅的物流公司主題：全幅底片顆粒碼頭照片加追蹤資訊列、固定的據點路線圖、配送天數表、疊加選單，去背棧板破出報價色帶。含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A bengara-red logistics theme: full-bleed dock photo with a tracking bar, sticky hub map, lead-time table and a cut-out pallet.
summary.ja: 弁柄色の物流会社テーマ。全幅の倉庫写真と追跡バー、固定の拠点路線図、配送日数表、帯を越える切り抜きパレット。
summary.fr: Un thème logistique rouge bengara : photo de quai pleine largeur, barre de suivi, carte des hubs et palette détourée.
